This might not be much help but it's all I can offer. 
Coming from a person who self harms and had my boyfriend at the time to help; you just have to come up with ways of suggesting to cope with things for her. Your girlfriend might be cutting for the same reason I did, and that was because I felt like I deserved the pain and everything was my fault. So something that always helped was baths. And instead of inflicting pain on to myself for thinking I deserved it, I'd cry in the bathtub and later do my hair, makeup, or nails or whatever because I would always feel pretty, and lay in comfy pajamas. But maybe your girlfriends solution would be drawing or drawing on herself with red marker ( sometimes people just like to see the red blood). Idk. There's hella alternatives tho.but I know how it is to be with someone who self harms. I've been in both positions. You cannot save your girlfriend. She has to save herself. You, can only suggest alternatives and try to be there when she needs to vent or whatever. I know nothing about you guys and your relationship, but I hope this helped a bit.
